notes.title: Preston Sterling becomes a free app
notes.content: Hello! We are pleased to announce that we will soon be releasing our new game "Monolith" on Steam. We have taken this as an opportunity to make our game "Preston Sterling" permanently available for free. The price change will still take a few days, so you should wait a little longer and come back here as soon as the game can be downloaded for free. In the meantime, use the waiting time to test the demo version of our new game Monolith, which is also free. We wish you lots of fun with that, too.
